interactionHelp: Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home.
settingsNote: Size, movement and home are saved on this Mac. Show and Animate apply for this session. Reduce Motion takes priority.
menuControlsHelp: Use the leaf in the menu bar to show or hide Mallow, pause or resume animation, bring it home, open Settings or Help, and quit Spriglet.
recoveryHelp: Hidden Mallow stays hidden through sleep, lock and display changes. Choose Show Mallow or Bring Home, or reopen Spriglet from Finder to recover it. Bring Home and Finder recovery return it to its resting home and preserve Pause.
localHelp: Everything stays on your Mac. Settings opens with keyboard focus; Help preserves focus in your current app. For support, email {{supportEmail}}.
